notes: s012 הָיוּ: them is read as the verb's own 3cp subject demoted to object by the recasting (rule 17) rather than as an `added` supplied object under rule 44; the unit note names the competing reading, as rule 8 requires.
Both closing construct phrases are rendered arthrously, so the written article takes the the standing before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one (rule 29).
מִקְשָׁה → of beaten work: the supplied of is the adverbial accusative's own (rule 33) and the head is beaten, work alone being any work (rule 31).
